page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, utilizing 32 physical cores with 1 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1108.99 and a Geekbench single-core score of 967.0, both falling in the bottom 25%. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also register in the lower tiers. Conversely, multi-core performance is average, with a Passmark CPU score of 23056.78 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8400.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks, such as large-block read-only operations at 87.55 GB/sec, and database operations scoring 8441.07 on Passmark, consistently align with middle-tier performance.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2.7xlarge is its lower single-threaded efficiency compared to its multi-threaded capabilities. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density make it suitable for workloads that can parallelize tasks across its 32 cores rather than relying on high single-core clock speeds. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, redis database operations, and medium-scale multi-threaded data processing.
